_about: Public-domain J. F. Ostervald, pastor of Neuchâtel, for the Word Hoard, in the English versions of his day: The Grounds and Principles of the Christian Religion, The Nature of Uncleanness Considered, The Arguments of the Books and Chapters of the Old and New Testament, An Abridgment of the History of the Bible, The Necessity and Usefulness of Reading the Holy Scriptures, Lectures on the Exercise of the Sacred Ministry, and A Compendium of Christian Theology; also his Latin Theologiae Christianae Compendium. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 128 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ostervald-abridgment: An abridgment of the history of the Bible. By the Rev. Mr Ostervald.  1750 (catalogued 1750)
ostervald-reading-scriptures: The necessity and usefulness of reading the Holy Scriptures; and the dispositions with which they ought to be read. Written originally in French, by the Rev. Mr. Ostervald: ... Translated by John Moore, A.B.  1750 (catalogued 1750)
ostervald-compendium-latin: Theologiae Christianae compendium; authore Johanne Friderico Osterwaldio, ...  1757 (catalogued 1757)

ostervald-compendium: A compendium of Christian theology (Strabane : Printed by John Bellew, 1785)
